Clothing and props use few broad three-tone material clusters, no fine painterly texture, no subpixel anti-aliased smoothing or intricate embroidery. This is one human static neutral master, not a sheet, portrait or multiple views.
Transparent RGBA output. No floor, cast shadow, scene, ground plate, grid, text, logo, frame, halo, haze, glow, bloom, particles or FX. Keep body and hand props readable at native1x. Standing only for this neutral master. No seated pose, floating palms, qi breath glow, aura, extra weapon or oversized scroll. Any palm qi is separate FX.
